Where to start

AbilityOne, and how Envision is built around it.

01 / 10
Federal Procurement Vehicle

The federal channel that brings qualified contracts to Envision.

AbilityOne is a federal program that establishes procurement priority for contracts performed by qualified nonprofit agencies employing people who are blind or have significant disabilities. It is a recognized contract vehicle, structured by law, governed by federal oversight.

For Envision, AbilityOne is not a credential. It is the operating environment.

1938
Year the federal program was established
~140
National Industries for the Blind agencies
Top
Envision sits among the largest of those agencies
Envision Workforce
01 What it does

Creates a federal procurement pathway

Federal buyers source goods and services from AbilityOne agencies under a recognized contracting framework, governed by the U.S. AbilityOne Commission and supported by NIB.

02 What it requires

Qualified employment standards

AbilityOne work must be performed by a workforce that is at least 75 percent employees who are blind or have significant disabilities. Envision exceeds that threshold.

03 How Envision fits

One of the largest qualified agencies

One of the largest and most capable AbilityOne agencies in the country, with active federal contracts, NIB-aligned compliance, and DOD program experience.

04 What it means here

A real channel into federal medical supply

For Steris, partnering with Envision creates direct exposure to a procurement pathway that is structurally important for federal healthcare contracts.

Why we are here

A look at Steris, and where we believe we can add value.

02 / 10

Before this conversation, Envision spent time understanding Steris as an organization, the markets you operate in, and the structural priorities shaping your business today.

Observation 01

A global infection prevention leader

Publicly traded global provider of sterilization, infection prevention, and surgical support solutions across healthcare, life sciences, and dental markets, with manufacturing facilities including Mentor, Ohio and Conroe, Texas.

Observation 02

A diverse and growing portfolio

The product mix spans capital equipment, consumables, specialty services, and reprocessing. That breadth creates multiple natural surface areas for an Envision partnership.

Observation 03

A meaningful federal healthcare footprint

Steris serves federal customers including the Department of Defense and Veterans Affairs. Federal procurement priorities continue to shift toward domestic sourcing.

Observation 04

Geographic proximity is a real asset

The Conroe, Texas manufacturing facility sits roughly three and a half hours from Envision's Dallas Campus. That proximity opens practical operational coordination on Texas-based programs.

What it tells us

This is the kind of partnership Envision was built for.

Steris operates at the intersection of healthcare, federal, and domestic manufacturing. Envision operates a qualified federal channel, production-grade capacity, and a workforce built for serious work.

That intersection is where a genuinely unique partnership becomes possible.

That is why we are here. Not to pitch a product. To explore where two organizations with complementary strengths can build something neither of us would build alone.

Where we could partner

Three pathways worth exploring together.

06 / 10

These are starting points, not commitments. The right partnership is the one that creates the most value for both organizations, in whatever combination makes sense.

Pathway OneAvailable now

Parts kitting and component packaging

Custom kitting and assembly of Steris components and consumables. Service parts, replacement kits, and complementary packaging.

  • Multi-component compatibility for repair components
  • Consumable kitting with inventory and labeling control
  • Familiar volume profile, low capability lift
  • Operational alignment with active OEM programs
Pathway TwoStructural framework

Mentor-Protégé partnership

A structured pathway for capability development and long-term industry inclusion. A formal mechanism for two organizations to grow together.

  • Recognized federal partnership framework
  • Formal mechanism for capability transfer
  • Long-term value creation for both partners
  • Workforce development tied to business outcomes
Pathway ThreeFuture state

ORLocate consumables

A future-state opportunity to support Steris with a domestic supply pathway for ORLocate-compatible consumables.

  • Domestic sourcing and packaging pathway
  • Federal procurement compatibility
  • Commercial market opportunity in parallel
  • Capability investment supported by partnership framework

Why these kits fit Envision

Multi-component service parts with mixed metal hardware, threaded fittings, and assembly hardware are the exact profile Envision builds today for federal and commercial OEMs. Same volume rhythm, same handling discipline, same quality controls.

What it would look like in Dallas

Envision receives bulk components from Steris, kits to SKU with verified bill-of-materials accuracy, applies branded packaging and labeling, and ships to Steris distribution or directly to the customer of record.

Pathway three, future state

ORLocate, and the domestic supply opportunity.

08 / 10
ORLocate System Future state
Surgical Gauze

Steris-only RFID surgical counting

ORLocate is a Steris-only system that uses RFID-tagged surgical gauze and sponges to enhance counting accuracy and reduce the risk of retained surgical items. The supporting consumables are a Steris-branded, Steris-tagged product line.

  • Designed to align with AORN counting guidelines
  • HF RFID handheld and locator hardware
  • Over 77 SKUs of tagged sponges, gauze, and towels

Representative consumable SKUs

A sample of the ORLocate-tagged product line. Each SKU is a candidate surface for a long-term domestic supply pathway through Envision.
